cites.quote: As former patriarchate official Sergei Chapnin documents in his book Religious Communities Under Pressure, the Russian Orthodox Church persecutes and disowns any of its clergy and laity who oppose the war on Ukraine.
Through dozens of case studies, an expert on Russian Orthodoxy describes the corruption of the Church he loves by its willful self-subordination to the power of the Kremlin.

Chapnin’s masterful ability to dispel three common misconceptions about the Russian religious landscape makes the book truly essential reading. … Through his meticulous research and insightful analysis, Chapnin paints a picture of a political regime and a national church united by a heretical ideology that portrays Ukraine and the West as demonic enemies of Russian religion, and the war on Ukraine as a sacred duty.

cites.quote: Chapnin's book does more than describe what is happening in Russia today — it answers the question 'why?' The study lays bare the God-defying nature of Putin's regime behind its outward tolerance of religious life.

Through his book, Chapnin continues the work of Keston, Amnesty International, the UN, and other organizations in documenting Russia’s malign treatment of clergy and laity who speak the truth and do not blindly follow the official stance of the government and the state-controlled Church. … An essential volume for a current view of the repressive actions of the Moscow Patriarchate led by Patriarch Kirill and the Russian state. Readers will find the research solid and convincing, and they will be disturbed by the limited reactions from Churches around the world.
